meta.source: L2J H5 datapack (Shagooh/l2j-server-datapack) quest sources + spawns + teleports + mapregion

dropRules.killer: Quest items go to the player who lands the killing blow (L2J `getQuestState(killer)`). In a party, others can tank/heal/damage, but the quest owner must finish the mob.
dropRules.solo: Solo-only kills: the quest checks that the owner is the only attacker (often with a special weapon or fists). Party members must NOT hit those mobs; they can still buff/heal/stand by.
dropRules.party: Shared drops (`getRandomPartyMemberState`): any party member who has the quest on the right step can receive the item, so the whole party can kill.
